blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified current StakedTrUSD implements FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE checks on sender/recipient transfers, staking and unstaking. The owner has BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Admin redistributeLockedAmount burns a restricted holder and remints to another address or redistributes value; seizeCooldown transfers restricted-holder silo funds. The owner cannot be blacklisted. Spoke pool mint/burn control is separate bridge risk.

oracleRisk.summary: Share conversion uses trUSD balance minus unvested rewards; authorized rewards and loss reports alter NAV. This is an upgradeable internal pricing authority, not an independent dollar oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: The ERC-4626 asset-per-share rate controls deposit and withdrawal amounts, without borrower debt or local liquidation branches.
